SERVICE TAX ACT 2018

SERVICE TAX (IMPOSITION OF TAX FOR TAXABLE SERVICE IN RESPECT OF
DESIGNATED AREAS AND SPECIAL AREAS) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section s 51 and 56 of the
Service Tax 2018 [Act  807], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1)   This order may be cited as the Service Tax (Imposition of Tax  for
Taxable Service in respect of Designated Areas and Special Areas) Order 2018.

(2) This Order comes into operation 1 September 2018.

Interpretation
2. For the purpose of this Order, "Regulations" means  the Service Tax
Regulations 2018.

Services chargeable to service tax
3. The services specified in column (1) of the Schedule  provided by the person
specified in column (2) of the Schedule shall be chargeable to service tax.
